description: Read a law by id. Short laws come whole. Long laws (100+ sections) return their front matter and a Contents list: then ask for one part, e.g. part: "section 86", "schedule 1", "regulation 3" or "part 2" (lists that part's sections).

id.description: Law id from search_laws, e.g. ukpga/1996/18

part.description: One section, regulation, article, schedule or part of a long law, e.g. "section 86"

name: get_law
title: Read a UK law
